It's easy even on the hardest difficulty and doing some side quests means you will outlevel any threat you find in main story. Quen is a lifesaver, while other signs don't do much. Hitting an enemy once with a quick attack and dodging is the most simple and effective strategy. So combat sucks. Skill tree is a joke, leveling up does nothing except silently improving stats and a new passive ability every 5 levels or so. Letting you use only some of the skills you unlocked at the same time punishes people for trying hybrid builds ( which I'd love to try ). I'd much prefer to see the tree from Witcher 2 or even the first one return.

That's about it as far as gameplay goes. The rest of the game is phenomenal. The world is interesting in its every bit, there's hidden lore behind many things, story is well written. Overall I enjoy it, but I wish they didn't screw up the important to me parts of a game
